items.headline: Apple to report Q4 2026 earnings after market close
items.summary: <cite index="4-1,4-8">Apple Inc. is set to announce its fourth-quarter earnings after the market closes on November 2, 2026. Analysts anticipate that Apple will report earnings per share (EPS) of $2 and revenue of $113.46 billion for Q4, up from last year's EPS of $1.85 and revenue of $102.46 billion.</cite>

items.headline: S&P Global cuts Meta's credit outlook to negative on AI spending concerns
items.summary: <cite index="10-1,10-2,10-3,10-4">S&P Global Ratings revised its outlook on Meta Platforms from stable to negative on November 2, citing uncertainties around the company's capital expenditure plans and free operating cash flow, with S&P forecasting Meta's capital expenditure at $135 billion to $145 billion annually.</cite>

items.headline: AWS Q3 revenue accelerates 39% to $46 billion
items.summary: <cite index="29-6,29-8">AWS revenue came in at $45.98 billion in Q3 2026, up 39% year-over-year and above the $45.29 billion consensus, generating $17.77 billion in third-quarter operating income, up 55%.</cite>

items.headline: Microsoft Azure revenue grows 48%, remains 72% size of AWS
items.summary: <cite index="29-1,29-2,30-8">Microsoft published its first earnings report with Azure cloud revenue reported separately, with Azure growing at 48% year-on-year and now 72% the size of AWS, up from 58% two years ago, while total revenue rose 19% year-on-year to $92.3 billion.</cite>

items.headline: Google Cloud revenue surges 103% in Q3
items.summary: <cite index="31-1,31-3">Google Cloud revenue jumped 103% year-on-year to $30.7 billion in Q3 2026, with Google Cloud, Azure, and AWS together bringing in $110 billion of revenue.</cite>

items.headline: Singapore banks fall ahead of earnings; OCBC leads losses as STI slides 1.4%
items.summary: <cite index="25-2,25-3">OCBC stock enters its results week under pressure after insurance subsidiary Great Eastern reported a steep decline in third-quarter profit, falling 72 percent year on year to 102.9 million Singapore dollars.</cite>

items.headline: OCBC Q3 2026 earnings scheduled for release
items.summary: <cite index="20-1,20-2">OCBC's next earnings date is estimated for November 6, 2026, based on past reporting schedules, with consensus EPS forecast of S$0.44.</cite>

items.headline: DBS Q3 2026 earnings scheduled for release
items.summary: <cite index="23-11">DBS is scheduled to report its third-quarter results on November 5, 2026, following UOB on November 4 and OCBC on November 6.</cite>

items.headline: UOB Q3 2026 earnings scheduled for release
items.summary: <cite index="25-5">UOB is scheduled to publish its third-quarter results on November 4, 2026, preceding DBS on November 5 and OCBC on November 6.</cite>

items.headline: Singapore market weakness as STI consolidates below key support levels
items.summary: <cite index="38-9,38-11,38-12">The STI has consolidated following its September highs with a 1GT Bearish signal still in play, with price breaking below the 5,600 support and consolidating around the 5,350-5,400 region while trading below the 20-day and 100-day moving averages.</cite>
